cases.purpose: On an ext2 loop filesystem with 20% reserved blocks (f_bavail < f_bfree) df reports Avail below Free-derived values and Use% = ceil(used/(used+avail)), byte-identical to GNU df in kB, inode, POSIX, byte and --total forms; an independent statfs oracle confirms avail < free.
cases.oracle: GNU df on the same filesystem and an independent statfs/stat -f computation of used/(used+avail).
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and file tree.
cases.script:
. ./rl.sh
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >o.txt 2>e.txt; local rc=$?; printf '[%s] status=%s\n' "$l" $rc; norm o.txt; echo "[stderr]"; norm e.txt; }
/usr/bin/truncate -s 4M a.img; $MK -q -t ext2 -m 20 -L DFRES a.img; at a.img; A=$REPLY; reg $A LOOP-A
/usr/bin/mkdir -p mnt; /usr/bin/mount $A mnt
r kb df -k --output=source,size,used,avail,pcent mnt
r inodes df -i mnt
r inodes-output df --output=source,itotal,iused,iavail,ipcent mnt
r default df -k mnt
r posix df -P mnt
r bytes df -B1 --output=size,used,avail mnt
r total df -k --total --output=size,used,avail,pcent mnt
bs=$(/usr/bin/stat -f -c %S mnt); tot=$(/usr/bin/stat -f -c %b mnt); fr=$(/usr/bin/stat -f -c %f mnt); av=$(/usr/bin/stat -f -c %a mnt)
used=$((tot-fr)); pc=$(( (used*100 + used+av - 1) / (used+av) ))
echo "oracle avail-lt-free=$((av<fr ? 1 : 0)) reserved-blocks=$((fr-av)) use-pct=$pc%"
